requirements.text: Enhance the customer experience significantly and bring the app in line with leading fintech competitors.
Deliver real-time push notifications for every transaction, including details like the amount spent, merchant name, and remaining balance.
Provide automated monthly spending breakdowns categorized by merchant types.
Enable customers to set personalized budgets and receive alerts when they are nearing or exceeding those budgets.
Implement biometric authentication using both fingerprint and facial recognition methods.
Provide in-app applications for overdrafts, personal loans, and credit limit changes.
Include an eligibility check using existing account data to determine qualification for lending services.
Provide a simplified application form for users to fill out for lending services.
Allow easy documentation uploads via photo or file selection for lending applications.
Enable a review step before the submission of lending applications.
Provide instant decision notifications upon application submission for lending services.
Ensure all new functionalities integrate with the existing core banking system via its current API layer.
Adhere to PSD2 regulations, particularly the Strong Customer Authentication requirements for all payment initiations and sensitive account access.
Ensure new lending features comply with the Central Bank of Ireland's consumer protection and responsible lending regulations.
Store and process customer financial data within the European Economic Area to comply with GDPR.
Maintain backwards compatibility with the existing app version for at least six months during the transition.
